scamList.metaDesc: Learn how common online scams in India work, spot the warning signs and stay safe.
scamList.title: Know the scams
scamList.intro: Pick a scam to see how it works, the warning signs and what to do about it.

scamDetail.exampleHint: This is what a scam can look like when it reaches you.
scamDetail.ifScammedIntro: Act fast. The first hour matters most.
scamDetail.shareFailed: Couldn't share. Copy the link from the address bar instead.
scamDetail.notFoundText: We couldn't find the scam you are looking for. The link may be wrong or the page may have moved.

helplinePage.metaDesc: Call 1930, find your state's cyber crime contacts and learn what to do in the first hour after a scam.
helplinePage.title: Get help now
helplinePage.intro: If you have been cheated online, act quickly. Calling within the first hour gives you the best chance of stopping the money.
helplinePage.nationalDesc: Tap the number to call from your phone.
helplinePage.call1930Label: Call the national cyber crime helpline 1930
helplinePage.noContacts: We don't have extra contacts for {{state}} yet. Please call 1930. It works across India.
helplinePage.firstHourTitle: What to do in the first hour
helplinePage.firstHourHint: Tick each step as you finish it.
helplinePage.step1: Call 1930 right away and tell them what happened.
helplinePage.step2: Inform your bank or wallet provider immediately and ask them to block the transaction or freeze the account.
helplinePage.step3: Keep screenshots of messages, call logs, payment receipts and the scammer's number or ID. Do not delete anything.
helplinePage.step4: Report on the national cyber crime portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and note down your complaint number.

quizPage.metaDesc: Take a short quiz to test how well you can spot online scams.
quizPage.title: Test your scam smarts
quizPage.intro: Answer a few questions to see how well you can spot scams.
quizPage.hint: Choose an answer. You can also press the number keys.
quizPage.msgHigh: Excellent! You are well prepared to spot scams. Share what you know with family and friends.
quizPage.msgMid: Good effort! Read about the scams to sharpen your instincts.
quizPage.msgLow: Don't worry, everyone starts somewhere. Read about the scams and try again.
quizPage.empty: No quiz questions are available right now.

reportPage.metaDesc: Tell us about a scam message or call you received so we can help warn others.
reportPage.title: Report a scam
reportPage.intro: Tell us about a scam message or call you received. Your report helps us warn others. This is not an official police complaint.
reportPage.official: To file an official complaint, call 1930 or use the cyber crime portal.
reportPage.messageHelp: Copy the message or describe the call. Write at least 10 characters.
reportPage.messagePlaceholder: Example: I got an SMS saying my bank account will be blocked and asking me to click a link…
reportPage.contactHelp: Phone or email, only if you want us to reach you.
reportPage.privacy: Privacy: Do not include passwords, OTPs, or bank details.
reportPage.consent: I agree to share this report to help warn others about scams.

errors.server: We couldn't send your report. Please try again.

reportPage.thanksText: Your report was received. Your reference number is:
reportPage.thanksSub: Keep this number if you need to refer to your report.

aboutPage.metaDesc: Cyber Suraksha helps people in India recognise online scams and know what to do if they are cheated.
aboutPage.title: About Cyber Suraksha
aboutPage.mission: Cyber Suraksha helps everyone, from students to grandparents, recognise online scams, stay safe and know exactly what to do if something goes wrong. We explain scams in simple words in English, Hindi and Marathi.
aboutPage.how1: Read about common scams and their warning signs.
aboutPage.how2: Take the quiz to test what you have learned.
aboutPage.how3: Find helpline numbers for your state.
aboutPage.how4: Report suspicious messages to help warn others.
aboutPage.langText: Use the language switcher in the header to read the site in English, Hindi or Marathi.
aboutPage.disclaimer: Cyber Suraksha is an awareness project. It is not a government service and does not replace legal or police advice. If you have lost money, call 1930 immediately.
